message.content: {"note_claim": "The video is not real Tesla Roadster test footage but an AI-generated meme video, not a rooftop hover test.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "AI-generated videos suggesting ways to use the Roadster and imagining 'what if the Roadster were on the road' are currently trending on social media.", "reason": "The page says Roadster videos circulating on social media (including city/road scenarios) are AI-generated 'what if' videos, and that the real Roadster unveiling had cold gas thrusters for wall climbing and short flights, supporting the note's claim that such viral clips are not real test footage."}
